response.description: Azure SRE Agent is an AI-driven solution that unifies operational workflows into a single, prompt-based automation layer—eliminating complexity and reducing overhead for modern cloud operations. Unlike traditional, static automation solutions, SRE Agent leverages AI and natural-language prompts to transform unstructured domain knowledge into dynamic, context-aware automation at scale. What's new:No-Code AutomationEmpower teams to tailor operational processes to their unique environments without engineering overhead—accelerating adoption and reducing time-to-value.Event-Driven TriggersEnable proactive checks and instant incident response to minimize downtime and protect revenue streams.Expanded ObservabilityGain deeper visibility across Azure and third-party sources to speed troubleshooting and root cause analysis.Orchestration Across MCP-Compatible ToolsIntegrate any MCP-compatible solution for end-to-end process automation, ensuring seamless workflows across your ecosystem.Adaptive Memory SystemSRE Agent learns from every interaction to continuously improve incident handling and reduce operational toil—helping organizations achieve higher reliability at lower cost.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: New integration and extensibility capabilities to Azure SRE Agent
